name: Marigold Town
chat: Welcome to Marigold Town! Copperleaf is up Hedgerow Lane, past the greenhouse.
The clinic heals your team for free. Just walk up to the door.
Tap the road sign to see where the road goes.
I once saw a Billie try to buy a cloud.
The ducks on the pond have names. I won’t tell you them.
Steps add up. My dog has walked to Tallgrass Meadow and back twice today.
The General Store sells Gold Cards. Very shiny.
They built a whole city in the middle of the world. Verdigris City, they call it.
Maple Row is the new street past the square. The leaves never stop falling there.
The orchard bees only sting people who talk about interest rates.

props.label: Bakery
props.say: The baker waves you in. It smells of cinnamon.
A cosy little house. A note on the door: “Gone to Copperleaf for honey.”

props.label: Community greenhouse
props.say: The community greenhouse. Tomatoes, peppers and a sign: “Seedlings for Copperleaf. Do not eat.”
